name: Toujou Tatsuya
source:
Tatsuya is a regular at sótano and a leader of a small, local criminal organization with an office near the bar.

At first glance, he looks gentle and businesslike, but he’s a suspicious fellow with the shady air of a Yakuza about him. He has some money invested in a local Italian restaurant, but he makes a big fuss about how rumors of it being a Yakuza hangout would be bad for business, so he frequents sótano instead.

He appears to be well acquainted with [url=https://vndb.org/c15394]Maki[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c15392]Hiroyuki[/url].

[From [url=http://mangagamerstaff.tumblr.com/post/111870257124/hm-well-you-certainly-are-an-energetic-young]MangaGamer[/url]]
